title: Growth wrapper semantic-role gate public rollout review

internal_quality_comparison.note: Ordinal mapping of existing wrapper quality labels for before/after comparison only; not a standalone quality score.

qualitative_review.finding: General declarative families no longer auto-select ask-topic merely because its priority is 4.
For ordinary event/relation/place contexts, judge-topic or interpret-topic can enter after question/decision wrappers are removed.
qualitative_review.note: These wrappers already carry equal or better internal quality metadata than ask-topic.

qualitative_review.finding: Quotation/hearsay families retain specialized read/write/ack/tell/reply wrappers.
quote-matsutake needs reaction wrappers as collision-safe fallback because most reporting names are already present inside the nested text.
qualitative_review.note: Reaction to quoted content is semantically defensible and preserves a minimum pool of eight.

rollout_rules: Apply v0.72 role gate only to automatic wrapper choice.
Manual dropdown continues to show all noun-collision-compatible wrappers.
Unknown/non-growth context uses broad fallback wrappers; dimension-restricted specialized wrappers are not auto-selected.
If the auto-compatible pool is empty, fall back to noun-compatible wrappers rather than disabling wrapping.
No wrapper text, palindrome reading, or growth family data is rewritten.
rollback_condition: CI finds fewer than five auto-compatible wrappers for a known narrative family.
A declarative final-stage context regains ask/ask-topic in auto top five without question evidence.
Public runtime loses manual access to a wrapper solely because of role gating.
progress_effect: This is the first transfer of the historical semantic-role gate into an existing long-form public generation path, not just a new candidate pool.
